- Q3 — WRITES_DISABLED master kill-switch: before James or the IoT team sets SALUS_IT500_CTL_ENABLED=true to activate iT500 setpoint control, someone must confirm where WRITES_DISABLED lives and that it is currently false (writes enabled): Confirm who owns the record of its current value and establish a process for checking it before any flag flip
